name: Crispy Ginger Pork Stir-Fry with Broccoli, Pepper, Mango & Cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat pork dry with paper towels and slice crosswise into thin strips. Place in a medium bowl, along with cornstarch, salt, and pepper, then toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 pork chops, boneless
4 tsp cornstarch
1 tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pork and cook, stirring occasionally, until golden, crispy, and cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Remove to a plate. (Reserve skillet with cooking juices for later use.)
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 crowns broccoli
2 mangoes
2 red bell peppers
2 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Place in a clean medium bowl.
Peel mangoes and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; medium dice the flesh. Add to the bowl with the broccoli.
Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips. Add to the bowl.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl.
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl.

Return the skillet (with cooking juices) to medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add veggies, mango, ginger, and garlic; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 3-4 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, place soy sauce, water, chili-garlic sauce, and honey in the reserved bowl, then whisk to combine the sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup soy sauce
4 tsp chili-garlic sauce
4 tsp honey

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are starting to soften, add sauce to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened slightly, 1-2 minutes more.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the skillet, along with the crispy pork, and stir once more to combine. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide stir-fry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
